about.title: About Us
paragraphs: Indomaja is a manufacturer and exporter of handcrafted decorative products made from authentic Indonesian natural materials. With over 30 years of experience in stone and 6 years in clay craftsmanship, we combine tradition, artistry, and reliability in every piece.

Based in East Java and Yogyakarta, we specialize in clay, stone, and vintage-inspired décor, all 100% handmade by skilled artisans. Our products are trusted globally, bringing the natural beauty and cultural richness of Indonesia to international markets.
